messages:
anya: Quick design proposal for a small-scope synthetic generator I'm calling 'traffic-weaver' — goal is apples-to-apples runtime perf tests covering kernel-selection, batching heuristics, and KV-cache behavior.

mike: ok cool. high-level goals?

anya: 1) deterministic (seeded) so runs are reproducible. 2) support multiple QPS shapes: linear ramps, sinusoidal, step bursts, heavy-tail spikes. 3) explicit KV-cache model (hit/miss + prefix reuse). 4) emit per-request annotations for kernel variant + batch size + kv_hit. 5) easy to plug into CI and perf harnesses.

raj: how are you modeling KV cache? real replays or synthetic distribution?

anya: both. two modes:
- replay: take a real prefix trace (from production logs scrubbed) and replay with timing jitter.
- stochastic: configurable prefix reuse probability distribution (e.g., Zipf/pareto for popular prefixes) + TTL to model eviction.

jessica: for batching heuristics we need to reproduce our continuous-batcher behavior: micro-window of 4-6ms, max_batch_size, and an adaptive cutoff when latency SLO would be violated. generator should allow toggling those knobs so we can run 'same config' across kernels.

mike: make sure the CLI has --seed and --seed-per-worker options. experiments get messed up if worker RNGs drift.

anya: agreed. example config snippet:
```
profile: hybrid_ramp
seed: 42
qps_profile:
  - {type: ramp, start: 10, end: 800, duration_s: 600}
  - {type: burst, qps: 4000, duration_s: 8, cadence_s: 120}
burst_shape: pareto(alpha=1.5, scale=1)
kv_model: {mode: replay, source: s3://bench/prefixes.tar.gz, jitter_ms: 10}
batcher: {window_ms: 5, max_batch: 64, adapt_latency_ms: 30}
emit_annotations: true
```

raj: For replay mode include snapshotting KV state so we can seed the runtime cache to a known state before each run — otherwise warmup noise kills apples-to-apples.

oleg: Add perf hooks: tag each request with kernel_name and kernel_version, and export to perf pipeline. Also capture wall-clock and cpu cycles; flame graphs per-kernel would be ideal.

deploy-bot: ci:bench/traffic-weaver triggered for branch "weaver/proof-of-concept" (job id: 84721)

jessica: long-tail shaping: include mixture models (exp + pareto) and also allow explicit tail-injection events (e.g., 1-in-1000 requests get huge seq_len or kv_miss burst) so we can exercise KV cold-miss cascades.

mike: for kernel-selection tests we should run with pinned model variants across nodes and also with our smart-routing policy enabled. record exact runtime config in every result bundle.

anya: result schema: run_id, seed, qps_profile, batcher_config, kv_snapshot_id, kernel_tags[], per_request_annotations (seq_len, batch_size, kv_hit, kernel_tag, latency_ms), aggregate histograms + raw samples.

raj: also capture queuing/wakeup latency and batch-formation time. those hide in the noise.

anya: plan: I'll push a PoC binary + sample configs to tools/benching by EOD tomorrow, then a short RFC for review. action items: anya -> PoC, raj -> KV snapshot tooling, oleg -> perf exporter tags, jessica -> batcher config matrix, mike -> CI job permutations.

mike: thanks. please include a reproducible command line for a single-run smoke test.

anya: will do. ping me if you want to pair on the replay sanitization. cc @raj @jessica @oleg :thumbsup:
